affected_subject.reason: Identifies WERC7575ShareToken batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers validator functions.

trigger_or_action.reason: Validator calling batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers to move balances to arbitrary addresses.

direct_effect.reason: Funds moved to non-KYC addresses and movement possible while paused.

summary: Report clearly identifies the affected batch transfer functions, the validator trigger, the KYC/pause bypass effect, and the violated KYC-gating invariant derived from standard transfer behavior.
